purpose: Registered reference sources for instrument-profile enrichment and universe classification.

tushare_hk_basic.notes: Use as listing_date/basic HK security metadata enrichment. Do not treat as security-type proof by default.

tushare_hk_daily.notes: Use as end-of-day HK reference bars for coverage/reconciliation and low-frequency sidecars. Do not treat as tick-level semantic proof.

tushare_hk_tradecal.notes: Use as HK market calendar reference for incremental scheduling and date coverage checks.

tushare_hk_adjfactor.notes: Use as adjustment-factor reference landing only. Requires a separate adjustment policy before adjusted prices enter research tables.

hkex_reit_manual_seed.notes: Curated REIT override seed maintained from official HKEX REIT market-data lists. Higher priority than secondary OpenD ETF classification.

hkex_southbound_manual_seed.notes: Legacy curated Southbound eligibility seed path. Prefer stock_connect_southbound_official for refreshes.

stock_connect_southbound_official.notes: Official Stock Connect Southbound eligible-security lists from SSE and SZSE. Eligibility is point-in-time; absence is not promoted to false in this sidecar.

eastmoney_hk_spot_market_snapshot.notes: Public HK quote snapshot. f20/f21 are total/circulating market cap references only; do not populate float_mktcap_hkd or verified fact tables.

opend_security_snapshot.notes: Current-security snapshot for listing-date backfill and secondary low-code non-equity classification. Do not promote to semantic proof by default.
